$comment: The cloud images the source machines of E3 to E6b start from (docs/BAREMETAL.md 21.2), each pinned by its SHA-256 from the distribution's signed checksum file (`checksums`). The URLs name a fixed build, never `latest`. openSUSE takes the btrfs flavour kvm-and-xen (Snapper, quota, GRUB2) because the Cloud flavour is XFS without Snapper; it has no cloud-init. Arch keeps only the last six builds on its mirrors: the pin of `arch` has to follow. A null sha256 is not pinned yet: run.mjs refuses that case until `node scripts/recovery-e2e/run.mjs --pin-images` (by hand, with network access) has written the hash of the image it downloaded and the maintainer committed it after comparing it with the checksum file of the distribution.
